$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-167 Stage 4, gate G-9. The SHARED contract both special-record
replay adapters are measured against: the TypeScript adapter in
tools/records/special-records-replay.ts (player_achievements, run by
tools/records/import-first-kick-goal.ts) and the Python branch in
tools/migration/common.py's replay_admin_overrides (after_siren_kicks, run
by tools/migration/after_siren.py).
D-3 (2026-09-13) approved ONE durable authority with TWO replay adapters, on
the condition that the two are pinned by parity tests. This file is that pin.
It is deliberately LANGUAGE-NEUTRAL data rather than two hand-written test
suites: hand-written cases on either side drift independently and the drift is
invisible until a rebuild loses somebody's decision. Here a case is written
once and BOTH adapters are asserted against it, so a semantic divergence fails
the suite instead of hiding.
EVERY case is expressed in columns BOTH tables carry -- player_name_raw,
player_name_clean, club_name_raw, season, round_raw, source_annotation, notes,
status, status_reason -- all of which AFLDB-ISSUE-167 §3.4 classifies amendable
for both families. The schemas genuinely differ beyond that (migration 053 vs
089), so each table carries its own `seedDefaults`/`recordDefaults` block
supplying only its own remaining NOT NULL columns. The SEMANTICS under test are
neutral; only the scaffolding needed to make a legal row is not.
The runner is tests/special-records-replay-parity.test.ts.

player_achievements.$comment: achievement_type and link_status_value are the only NOT NULL columns migration 053 leaves without a default beyond the neutral set. link_status_value MUST stay outside ('unique','resolved') while player_id is NULL or player_achievements_link_ck refuses the row.

after_siren_kicks.$comment: Migration 089 leaves fourteen more NOT NULL columns without a default, and four CHECKs couple them. kick_effect='none' + kicker_result='loss' + siren='final' satisfies after_siren_kicks_effect_ck's third branch and after_siren_kicks_regulation_ck; premiership_season=true satisfies after_siren_kicks_match_ck with a NULL match_id; non-negative points satisfy after_siren_kicks_points_ck.

seedRow.$comment: The starting state of a target row, in neutral columns only.

cases.name: lifecycle on a present row applies the decision
lifecycle naming an absent row WARNS AND RETAINS
cases.requirement: §8.4 — a manifest that stopped carrying a row is not a reason to discard the decision

cases.name: correction on a present row applies a DELTA, key presence being the semantics
cases.requirement: §5.2 correction — absent key leaves the source value, explicit JSON null clears it (migration 086 discipline)

cases.name: correction naming an absent row FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §8.4 — the reload stops rather than silently reverting a human decision

expect.messageContains: correction target row does not exist

cases.name: record re-creates the manual row a destructive rebuild removed
cases.requirement: §5.2 record — RE-CREATE, then restore the payload

cases.name: record re-creates a VOIDED manual row and voids it again
cases.requirement: §5.2 — is_active is always true; the lifecycle lives in the payload's status, because a voided row must be re-created and voided again, never suppressed

cases.name: a record payload whose player_identity does not resolve FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §8.4 — a record override whose player/match identity cannot be resolved FAILS CLOSED. A manual row silently coming back UNLINKED would lose the linkage without saying so.

expect.messageContains: player_identity does not resolve to exactly one player

cases.name: a record payload whose player_identity resolves restores the link
cases.requirement: The positive half: a manual row comes back LINKED, and player_achievements_link_ck / after_siren_kicks_link_ck make (link_status IN ('unique','resolved')) = (player_id IS NOT NULL) a hard invariant, so a replay that set one without the other would be refused by the database.

cases.name: a record payload that cannot be reconstructed FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §8.4 — a record override that cannot be reconstructed FAILS CLOSED

expect.messageContains: record payload is missing a required field

cases.name: two applicable overrides resolving to one entity_key FAIL CLOSED
cases.requirement: §8.4 — Phase E §12 verbatim. A 'record' override owns the whole row INCLUDING its status, so pairing it with a second authority over the same row makes the outcome order-dependent. 'correction' + 'lifecycle' is NOT a collision: they own disjoint fields and replay in a defined order.

expect.messageContains: more than one active override resolves to this row

cases.name: correction and lifecycle on one row are NOT a collision
cases.requirement: The negative half of the collision rule: disjoint authority replays in a defined order (correction, then lifecycle) in both adapters.

cases.name: an entity_key that is not '<source key>:<source_record_id>' FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §5.3 grammar parity — an unparseable key is worse than no key, because it attaches a durable decision to nothing

cases.name: an entity_key whose source key names no source FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §5.3 grammar parity — the source key half must resolve, or the record id half is bound to nothing

expect.messageContains: entity_key names no source in this database

cases.name: an entity_key whose record id half is empty FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §5.3 grammar parity — both halves must be non-empty; the source uniqueness constraints are UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT, so an empty identity collapses distinct rows rather than distinguishing them

expect.messageContains: entity_key carries no source record id

cases.name: an unknown field_group FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §5.2 — the three groups are closed; a fourth is a decision nothing knows how to replay

cases.name: a lifecycle payload carrying no valid status FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §6.1 — status IN ('active','void') is a CHECK on both tables; a payload that cannot satisfy it must be refused before it is written, not after

cases.name: a void payload carrying no status_reason FAILS CLOSED
cases.requirement: §6.1 — *_void_reason_ck. Leaving a void unexplained loses the only thing separating a data-entry error from a fact that really happened

expect.messageContains: a void row needs a status_reason
